Ultimate Fried Pickle Wagyu Burgers with Tangy Yellow Mustard

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 3:02
Instaread

If you love a juicy burger packed with crunch, flavor, and a kick of nostalgia, this Fried Pickle Wagyu Burger is about to become your new favorite recipe!

We’re taking rich, tender Wagyu beef patties, pairing them with warm toasted brioche buns, razor-thin crisp white onions, and piling on crispy, golden-fried dill pickle slices with plenty of tangy yellow mustard. This is the exact burger I created for the Heinz contest years ago—a recipe that deserves to be saved and savored! Every bite delivers the ultimate balance of savory, crispy, and tangy goodness.

Why You’ll Love This Recipe

  • Juicy Wagyu Beef: Rich, buttery, and grilled to perfection.
  • Crispy Fried Pickles: Thick-cut dill pickles dipped in egg wash, coated in flour, and fried until golden brown.
  • Tangy Mustard & Crisp Onions: Crisp white onions soaked in cold water layered with plenty of classic yellow mustard.

Ultimate Fried Pickle Wagyu Burgers with Tangy Yellow Mustard

athomewithrebecka
Take burger night to the next level with juicy Wagyu beef patties, crispy golden fried pickles, and tangy yellow mustard on toasted brioche buns!
No ratings yet
Print Recipe Pin Recipe
Prep Time 15 minutes mins
Cook Time 12 minutes mins
Course Entree
Cuisine American
Servings 4 people
Calories 722 kcal

Ingredients
  

For the Fried Pickles

  • 1 jar 16 oz thick-cut dill pickle slices (save the juice!)
  • 1 large egg
  • ½ cup milk
  • ¾ cup all-purpose flour
  • 1 teaspoon seasoned salt
  • Vegetable oil for frying

For the Burgers & Assembly

  • 4 ground Wagyu beef patties
  • 4 brioche buns buttered
  • 1 large white onion thinly sliced
  • Heinz Yellow Mustard to taste
  • Toothpicks for assembly

Instructions
 

  • Step 1: Prep the Onions & Pickles
  • Thinly slice the white onion and submerge the slices in a bowl of cold water (this keeps them extra crisp and mellows the raw onion bite).
  • Drain the pickle slices thoroughly. (Pro-Tip: Keep the pickle juice in the fridge to use for brining chicken or pork chops!)
  • Step 2: Bread & Fry the Pickles
  • In a small mixing bowl, whisk together the egg and milk.
  • In a shallow baking dish, combine the flour and seasoned salt.
  • Dip each pickle slice into the egg wash, then coat directly in the flour mixture. Set flour-coated pickles on a paper-towel-lined baking sheet until all are prepped.
  • Heat vegetable oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Fry the pickles in batches until golden brown and crispy. Transfer to paper towels to drain.
  • Step 3: Grill the Burgers & Buns
  • Cook the Wagyu beef patties on a hot grill until they reach your desired level of doneness.
  • Butter the brioche buns and toast them on the grill until lightly browned.
  • Step 4: Assemble & Serve
  • Spread a generous layer of yellow mustard on both the top and bottom toasted buns.
  • Drain the onions on paper towels and divide them evenly on the bottom buns.
  • Add the cooked Wagyu patties, a generous stack of hot fried pickles, and another drizzle of yellow mustard.
  • Top with the bun, secure with a toothpick (spear a fried pickle on top for garnish!), and enjoy immediately!
